status_label: Portal accounts can usually be created; loan/upkeep application windows are cycle-specific — confirm live
note: Separate two things: (1) Creating a NELFUND student account on portal.nelf.gov.ng is often available even when a loan application cycle is closed. (2) Loan and upkeep applications only work during an officially open registration window for that session. A yellow notice with past end dates means that session window has closed — it is not the same as account creation closing. BVN is typically needed to complete bank details before disbursement/application steps that require it; students can often start account setup while arranging BVN. Always confirm live dates on nelf.gov.ng and portal.nelf.gov.ng — this guide does not invent opening dates.
disclaimer: Curated guidance only — students must confirm current openness on official channels. Unofficial social media dates are not authoritative.
